Title: Freeze v7 domain boundaries and contracts
UserStory: As the product team, we need one approved v7 baseline so all teams build the same system.
ScopeSummary: Merge v5 core + v6 review + v7 five-candidate paywall rule; publish schema/API decisions.
AcceptanceCriteria: Signed architecture checklist; versioned ADRs; no unresolved P0 domain ambiguity.

Title: Create versioned SQL Server baseline migration
UserStory: As engineering, we need a reproducible database baseline.
ScopeSummary: Unify employer, candidate, billing, CRM, alerts, moderation, paywall and audit tables.
AcceptanceCriteria: Clean deploy to empty DB; migration idempotency/version gate; schema validation passes.

Title: Freeze GraphQL v7 product contract
UserStory: As client teams, we need stable product-facing APIs.
ScopeSummary: Identity/personas, jobs, filters/facets, applications, billing, unlock/paywall, CRM, alerts.
AcceptanceCriteria: Schema validates; no DB-table-shaped public API; deprecations documented.

Title: Seed taxonomy and dynamic role requirement templates
UserStory: As users, we need consistent role/specialisation data on both employer and candidate flows.
ScopeSummary: JobFamily, Role, Specialisation, WorkContext, skills, credentials, assets, aliases and templates.
AcceptanceCriteria: Seed version tracked; representative Driver/Delivery/Nurse/Accountant/Technician flows resolve.

Title: Implement outbox/inbox and idempotency primitives
UserStory: As the platform, we need reliable external and asynchronous workflows.
ScopeSummary: Outbox, webhook inbox, idempotency store, retry/dead-letter conventions.
AcceptanceCriteria: Duplicate request/webhook does not duplicate application, payment, unlock or usage events.

Title: Define job and candidate search projection contracts
UserStory: As mobile/recruiter clients, we need low-latency search without OLTP join explosions.
ScopeSummary: Projection documents, facet fields, privacy exclusions, version/watermark rules.
AcceptanceCriteria: Projection excludes raw contact/identity data; rebuild procedure documented.

Title: Create CI/CD, feature flags and environment baseline
UserStory: As engineering, we need safe repeatable deployment.
ScopeSummary: DB migrations, API validation, frontend/mobile feature flags, secret/config separation.
AcceptanceCriteria: Pipeline blocks schema/API validation failures and supports rollback/feature disable.

Title: Implement UserAccount, verified identifiers and OTP challenges
UserStory: As a candidate/employer, I can authenticate using OTP.
ScopeSummary: Mobile/email identifiers, OTP hash/TTL/attempts/resend, provider delivery audit.
AcceptanceCriteria: OTP is single-use, rate limited and never logged in plaintext.

Title: Implement persistent user sessions, devices and token rotation
UserStory: As a user, I stay signed in securely and can revoke sessions.
ScopeSummary: Refresh token hashes, session/device records, rotate/revoke/logout/risk revocation.
AcceptanceCriteria: Reused/revoked refresh token cannot mint a session; session list works.

Title: Create lightweight CandidateProfile and persona switching
UserStory: As a user, I can be a candidate without a full profile and may also be an employer.
ScopeSummary: CandidateProfile stub, activePersona, availablePersonas, onboarding state.
AcceptanceCriteria: OTP can route directly to jobs; same UserAccount can own both personas.

Title: Implement organisation creation and membership RBAC
UserStory: As an employer owner, I can create/manage an organisation tenant.
ScopeSummary: Organisation, OWNER/ADMIN/RECRUITER/VIEWER/BILLING_ADMIN membership and authorization.
AcceptanceCriteria: Every employer mutation validates active membership and role.

Title: Implement organisation verification and commercial identity
UserStory: As the platform, we identify the real commercial organisation for trust and trial abuse control.
ScopeSummary: PAN/GSTIN/CIN/LLPIN evidence metadata, verification state, legal-entity fingerprint.
AcceptanceCriteria: Sensitive identifiers protected; duplicate legal entity is detectable.

Title: Provision default free evaluation allowance of five distinct candidate unlocks
UserStory: As a new organisation, I can evaluate IndiaWorks using up to five distinct candidates.
ScopeSummary: Create FREE_EVALUATION entitlement policy: CANDIDATE_UNLOCK limit=5, reset=NONE, organisation/legal-entity scoped.
AcceptanceCriteria: All recruiters share the same allowance; same candidate counts once across all jobs; new user does not reset allowance.

Title: Implement recruiter invitations and seat-aware membership lifecycle
UserStory: As an organisation owner, I can invite recruiters safely.
ScopeSummary: Invite, expiry, accept/revoke, pending state, seat pre-check.
AcceptanceCriteria: Invite cannot exceed hard paid seat limit; accepted invitation is idempotent.

Title: Expose v7 authentication/persona GraphQL operations
UserStory: As clients, we can request/verify OTP, refresh/logout and switch persona.
ScopeSummary: Candidate/employer auth, active sessions, persona switch, identifier change.
AcceptanceCriteria: GraphQL contract returns predictable error codes and next route.

Title: Implement plan/version/entitlement service
UserStory: As the SaaS, all paid/free feature access is centrally evaluated.
ScopeSummary: Plan versions, entitlements, reset cadence, enforcement mode, entitlement evaluator.
AcceptanceCriteria: Plan versions immutable after sale; evaluator returns ALLOW/DENY/METER.

Title: Implement payment provider adapter and checkout abstraction
UserStory: As an organisation, I can purchase monthly/yearly access.
ScopeSummary: Provider customer, checkout/order session, invoice/payment abstraction, idempotency.
AcceptanceCriteria: Server controls amount/plan; no client supplied price accepted.

Title: Implement signed webhook inbox and subscription reconciliation
UserStory: As the platform, subscription status follows provider events reliably.
ScopeSummary: Webhook signature, inbox, retries, invoice/payment/subscription state transitions.
AcceptanceCriteria: Duplicate provider event changes state once; reconciliation is auditable.

Title: Implement OrganisationSubscription lifecycle and upgrade/downgrade rules
UserStory: As an organisation, I can start, renew, cancel or change a plan.
ScopeSummary: TRIALING/ACTIVE/PAST_DUE/SUSPENDED/CANCEL_AT_PERIOD_END/CANCELLED/EXPIRED.
AcceptanceCriteria: Entitlements reflect status consistently; cancellation never deletes historical jobs/applications.

Title: Create OrganisationCandidateUnlock and access audit model
UserStory: As the platform, distinct candidate access is durable and deduplicated.
ScopeSummary: Unique organisation+candidate unlock; source FREE_ALLOWANCE/PAID_ENTITLEMENT/ADMIN; job attribution; actor/audit.
AcceptanceCriteria: Concurrent requests cannot consume multiple free unlocks for the same candidate.

Title: Implement five-free candidate unlock decision service
UserStory: As an organisation, I get five free distinct candidate unlocks and the sixth requires payment.
ScopeSummary: Masked results do not consume; re-opening unlocked candidate is free; 6th distinct candidate checks active paid entitlement; free allowance never resets.
AcceptanceCriteria: Exact boundary tests: unlocks 1-5 ALLOW_FREE, candidate 6 PAYWALL_REQUIRED without paid plan; same candidate never increments twice.

Title: Expose candidate access status/paywall GraphQL contract
UserStory: As employer UI, I can show remaining free unlocks and paywall at the exact boundary.
ScopeSummary: candidateAccessStatus, unlockCandidateProfile, accessDecision/paywall reason, upgrade CTA metadata.
AcceptanceCriteria: Mutation is idempotent and never returns full profile when decision is PAYWALL_REQUIRED.

Title: Build subscription/paywall UI shell and usage meter
UserStory: As an employer, I understand free usage, upgrade choices and paid usage.
ScopeSummary: 5/5 meter, sixth-candidate paywall modal, plan comparison, checkout/return states.
AcceptanceCriteria: Paywall triggers only on protected action; masked lists remain usable.

Title: Implement free-allowance/trial abuse controls
UserStory: As the business, organisations cannot repeatedly recreate accounts to reset five free candidates.
ScopeSummary: Legal-entity fingerprint, verified-domain/mobile/device/risk signals, admin override with audit.
AcceptanceCriteria: Known duplicate legal entity does not receive a fresh allowance without approved override.

Title: Implement role-driven job requirement templates
UserStory: As an employer, choosing a role generates relevant structured fields.
ScopeSummary: Default skills, credentials, assets, education/languages, screening prompts and gates by role/specialisation.
AcceptanceCriteria: Representative role templates render without irrelevant mandatory fields.

Title: Implement draft job create/edit and field validation
UserStory: As a recruiter, I can create a complete structured job.
ScopeSummary: Role/specialisation/work context, engagement/work mode, vacancies, urgency, description, validation.
AcceptanceCriteria: Draft saves partially; publish returns field-level validation errors.

Title: Implement locations, schedule, compensation, benefits and contact policy
UserStory: As a recruiter, I capture details candidates filter on.
ScopeSummary: Geo/radius, shift/timing, monthly/daily/hourly pay, bonus/incentive, benefits, call/WhatsApp windows.
AcceptanceCriteria: No critical search field is buried only in free-text description.

Title: Implement screening questions and interview windows
UserStory: As a recruiter, I can ask just-in-time questions and publish interview/walk-in information.
ScopeSummary: Question definitions/options/gate; interview windows/location/instructions/visibility.
AcceptanceCriteria: Application answers always reference a valid job question version.

Title: Implement job moderation state machine
UserStory: As the marketplace, published jobs can be reviewed without corrupting job lifecycle state.
ScopeSummary: PENDING_REVIEW/APPROVED/REJECTED/SUSPENDED independent from DRAFT/PUBLISHED/etc.
AcceptanceCriteria: Only approved + published + unexpired jobs are discoverable.

Title: Implement job publish/pause/close/expire with entitlement enforcement
UserStory: As a recruiter, I publish only within organisation plan limits.
ScopeSummary: ACTIVE_JOBS/JOB_POSTS checks, status history, expiry worker.
AcceptanceCriteria: Publish transaction cannot leave quota consumed if publish fails.

Title: Implement stable public job links and share attribution
UserStory: As a candidate, shared jobs open reliably on web/app.
ScopeSummary: JobPublicLink, JobShareLink, channel/attribution token, stable slug/public code.
AcceptanceCriteria: Link survives title edit; closed job shows safe closed state.

Title: Expose complete JobDetail/authoring GraphQL contract
UserStory: As clients, job detail is structured and complete.
ScopeSummary: Job details, schedule, compensation, benefits, requirements, contact actions, public share URL.
AcceptanceCriteria: Schema supports mobile detail page without parsing description.

Title: Build employer jobs dashboard and job lifecycle actions
UserStory: As a recruiter, I manage drafts/published/paused/closed jobs.
ScopeSummary: Filters/status counts, edit/duplicate/pause/close/refresh actions, moderation status.
AcceptanceCriteria: Action availability follows RBAC + status + entitlement.

Title: Build mobile OTP onboarding and jobs landing flow
UserStory: As a candidate, OTP takes me directly to jobs.
ScopeSummary: OTP screens, terms/privacy notice, session persistence, basic city prompt when needed.
AcceptanceCriteria: Full profile/resume/Aadhaar/PAN not mandatory for feed.

Title: Build job search projection and indexer
UserStory: As candidates, job results are fast and facet-ready.
ScopeSummary: Projection includes taxonomy, geo, pay, shift, freshness, urgency, benefits, trust, promotion metadata.
AcceptanceCriteria: Index rebuildable; PII/secrets excluded.

Title: Implement canonical JobSearchInput and contextual facets
UserStory: As a candidate, filters are accurate and counts update contextually.
ScopeSummary: Role, specialisation, location/radius, work mode, type, experience, education/course, salary, shift, posted date, urgency, skills/languages/credentials/assets, benefits, trust/source/industry.
AcceptanceCriteria: Facet counts reflect current query/geography; stable cursor sort.

Title: Implement personalised job feed and relevance explanations
UserStory: As a candidate, I see relevant nearby jobs even with a partial profile.
ScopeSummary: Hard eligibility, role/location/availability relevance, freshness; explanation codes.
AcceptanceCriteria: Incomplete profile does not block feed; missing info produces UNKNOWN/WARN, not hidden job by default.

Title: Build job list, filters and job detail experience
UserStory: As a candidate, I can filter, inspect and understand a job.
ScopeSummary: Job cards, facet sheets, detail sections, distance, salary, shift, requirements, employer trust.
AcceptanceCriteria: Selected filters survive navigation and deep links.

Title: Implement application readiness hard-vs-soft requirement evaluation
UserStory: As a candidate, preferred mismatches warn me but do not unnecessarily block me.
ScopeSummary: HARD BLOCK vs WARN vs missing info, just-in-time field requests.
AcceptanceCriteria: Only explicit legal/safety/credential hard gates block submission.

Title: Implement one-tap apply with snapshots and idempotency
UserStory: As a candidate, I can apply with minimal taps.
ScopeSummary: CandidateApplication, application/job snapshots, question answers, event log.
AcceptanceCriteria: Repeated mobile retry returns same application; closed job race is handled.

Title: Implement save job and share/deep-link flows
UserStory: As a candidate, I can save/share a job via WhatsApp/other channels.
ScopeSummary: SavedJob, share link generation, Android App Links/iOS Universal Links/mobile-web fallback.
AcceptanceCriteria: Share click can be attributed; closed/expired job degrades gracefully.

Title: Implement candidate call/message employer policy
UserStory: As a candidate, I can contact HR only when the job permits it.
ScopeSummary: Channel/time windows, masked/direct number policy, contact event audit.
AcceptanceCriteria: Outside-window requests explain next available time; block/report is enforced.

Title: Build My Applications and application status timeline
UserStory: As a candidate, I can track and withdraw applications.
ScopeSummary: Application list, status/event timeline, withdrawal.
AcceptanceCriteria: Historical snapshot remains after job edits/closure.

Title: Build applicant inbox with masked candidate cards
UserStory: As a recruiter, I can see who applied while the five-candidate commercial gate remains enforceable.
ScopeSummary: Applicant counts/list, masked candidate summary, access state for each candidate.
AcceptanceCriteria: Viewing list does not consume free unlock; no contact PII before unlock.

Title: Enable free unlock for first five distinct candidates from applicant inbox
UserStory: As a new organisation, I can evaluate five applicants in full.
ScopeSummary: unlockCandidateProfile from application context; OrganisationCandidateUnlock record.
AcceptanceCriteria: Distinct unlocks 1-5 succeed; re-open same candidate never increments count.

Title: Enforce sixth-candidate paywall across employer applicant UI
UserStory: As an unpaid organisation, the sixth distinct candidate is gated by an upgrade paywall.
ScopeSummary: Disable protected full-profile/contact action after five; show remaining counter and monthly/yearly upgrade.
AcceptanceCriteria: All recruiters see shared 5/5 state; no client-side bypass.

Title: Create persistent EmployerCandidateRelationship
UserStory: As a recruiter, the candidate remains in my organisation pipeline across jobs.
ScopeSummary: Unique organisation+candidate relation, stage/source/owner, job links.
AcceptanceCriteria: One relationship can reference multiple jobs/applications.

Title: Implement contact reveal policy for free-unlocked and paid candidates
UserStory: As an employer, contact is available only after candidate access, consent and plan rules.
ScopeSummary: Free first-five candidate can reveal permitted contact without second free-candidate charge; paid plan uses CONTACT_REVEAL entitlement as configured.
AcceptanceCriteria: Reveal is idempotent, audited and blocked when candidate/organisation is blocked.

Title: Implement notes, tags, ownership and pipeline stages
UserStory: As a recruiting team, we collaborate on candidate follow-up.
ScopeSummary: Notes, org-scoped tags, assigned owner, SAVED/CONTACTED/SCREENING/INTERVIEWING/OFFERED/HIRED.
AcceptanceCriteria: RBAC and audit identify authors/changes.

Title: Implement interview scheduling entity and workflow
UserStory: As a recruiter, I can schedule an interview and candidate can see it.
ScopeSummary: Interview type/time/timezone/location/status/outcome.
AcceptanceCriteria: Changes create audit/notification events.

Title: Implement offer and hire workflow
UserStory: As a recruiter, I can make/track an offer and mark hire.
ScopeSummary: Offer status, start date, compensation snapshot, expiry, acceptance/decline.
AcceptanceCriteria: HIRED is auditable and linked to application/job/organisation.

Title: Audit candidate unlock/paywall/reveal funnel
UserStory: As product, we measure the commercial conversion boundary.
ScopeSummary: Unlock attempt/decision, remaining free count, paywall shown, checkout started/completed, contact reveal.
AcceptanceCriteria: No raw phone/email in analytics events.

Title: Build candidate search projection/index
UserStory: As paid recruiters, candidate search is fast and privacy-safe.
ScopeSummary: Discoverability, roles/specialisations, skills, experience, coarse geo, languages, credentials flags, availability.
AcceptanceCriteria: Phone/email/raw identity docs excluded; block/consent flags enforced.

Title: Implement employer candidate search and job-match filters
UserStory: As a recruiter, I can find candidates matching a job or custom criteria.
ScopeSummary: Role, skills, experience, location/radius, availability, languages, credentials, work preferences, verification filters.
AcceptanceCriteria: Search returns masked candidates and match explanations; entitlement checked centrally.

Title: Expose masked candidate result cards with access state
UserStory: As a recruiter, I can evaluate result relevance before spending an unlock.
ScopeSummary: Masked card + ALREADY_UNLOCKED/FREE_REMAINING/PAYWALL/PAID_ACCESS state.
AcceptanceCriteria: Masked cards never leak contact PII or exact address.

Title: Enable candidate unlock from database search with same five-free rule
UserStory: As an unpaid org, applicant and database unlocks share one five-candidate allowance.
ScopeSummary: Same OrganisationCandidateUnlock table and dedupe across source contexts.
AcceptanceCriteria: If 4 candidates unlocked from applicants, only 1 free unlock remains in search.

Title: Meter paid CANDIDATE_UNLOCK entitlement for monthly/yearly plans
UserStory: As a paid organisation, unlocks follow plan quota or unlimited entitlement.
ScopeSummary: Usage event with billing period and idempotency; add-on extension supported.
AcceptanceCriteria: Usage cannot be double counted; quota exhaustion returns upgrade/add-on action.

Title: Meter paid CONTACT_REVEAL entitlement and access audit
UserStory: As a paid organisation, contact reveals follow plan rules.
ScopeSummary: Consent/privacy first, candidate unlock second, contact reveal entitlement third.
AcceptanceCriteria: Payment never overrides candidate consent or block state.

Title: Implement recruiter saved candidate searches
UserStory: As a recruiter, I can save common candidate queries.
ScopeSummary: Versioned filter JSON, job-linked or custom search, owner/share within organisation.
AcceptanceCriteria: Saved search replays deterministically against current index.

Title: Implement add-on candidate unlock/contact credit purchase
UserStory: As a customer, I can buy additional credits without changing base plan.
ScopeSummary: One-time add-on checkout and entitlement grant.
AcceptanceCriteria: Credits reconcile through same billing inbox/usage ledger.

Title: Gate export/API/ATS features by plan
UserStory: As the SaaS, bulk data access is controlled separately from normal search.
ScopeSummary: BULK_EXPORT/API_ACCESS/ATS_CONNECTOR entitlements, scope/rate limits/audit.
AcceptanceCriteria: No unrestricted candidate PII export by default.

Title: Implement versioned SavedJobSearch for candidates
UserStory: As a candidate, I can save a filter configuration.
ScopeSummary: Canonical JobSearchInput JSON + schema version + sort + name/default.
AcceptanceCriteria: Saved filter migrates or clearly fails if schema version becomes unsupported.

Title: Implement job alert subscriptions and preferences
UserStory: As a candidate, I can receive instant/daily/weekly/custom alerts.
ScopeSummary: Channel, timezone, quiet hours, consent, active/pause state.
AcceptanceCriteria: Turning off WhatsApp does not disable account or other channels.

Title: Implement alert run, watermark and delivery deduplication
UserStory: As the platform, alerts do not repeatedly spam the same candidate with the same job.
ScopeSummary: JobAlertRun, JobAlertDelivery, watermark, delivery-window dedupe, retry status.
AcceptanceCriteria: Same job/channel/search is not resent inside configured dedupe window.

Title: Implement promotion products and promotion-credit entitlement
UserStory: As an employer, I can buy/use a promotion product.
ScopeSummary: Configurable placement, duration, max boost, credit cost/price, eligibility.
AcceptanceCriteria: Closed/unapproved job cannot start promotion.

Title: Build promote-job employer UX and activation flow
UserStory: As a recruiter, I can understand and activate a boost.
ScopeSummary: Product selection, included credit vs add-on price, schedule/status.
AcceptanceCriteria: Idempotent purchase/activation and clear disclosure.

Title: Apply bounded commercial boost after relevance
UserStory: As candidates, promoted jobs remain relevant and safe.
ScopeSummary: Hard eligibility -> relevance -> quality/freshness -> bounded promotion boost.
AcceptanceCriteria: Promotion can never bypass consent, credential/legal gates, job state or hard location.

Title: Integrate push/WhatsApp/SMS/email notification adapters
UserStory: As users, transactional notifications arrive through configured channels.
ScopeSummary: Provider abstraction, templates, delivery callbacks, opt-out and failure handling.
AcceptanceCriteria: Provider IDs/status tracked; sensitive payload minimized.

Title: Implement promotion attribution funnel
UserStory: As product/employers, we measure promotion lift.
ScopeSummary: Impression -> view -> apply -> contact/hire attribution with promotion id.
AcceptanceCriteria: Dashboard separates paid placement from organic baseline.

Title: Implement job refresh/freshness policy
UserStory: As candidates, active listings remain fresh.
ScopeSummary: LastRefreshedAt, publication events, allowed refresh cadence, stale expiry policy.
AcceptanceCriteria: Refresh cannot bypass moderation or plan active-job limits.

Title: Implement marketplace report and block flows
UserStory: As users, I can report or block abusive jobs/organisations/candidates.
ScopeSummary: Report reasons, candidate-organisation block, enforcement in search/alerts/contact.
AcceptanceCriteria: Blocked pair cannot contact or discover each other through protected surfaces.

Title: Implement consent, retention, deletion/export and access audit operations
UserStory: As a user/platform, privacy choices are enforceable and auditable.
ScopeSummary: Purpose consent, discoverability, contact/reveal audit, retention workflows, deletion/export requests.
AcceptanceCriteria: Search projection removes candidates when discoverability/retention requires it.

Title: Build moderation/support case console
UserStory: As support/admin, I can resolve job/company/candidate reports.
ScopeSummary: Case queue, evidence, actions, suspension, notes, audit trail.
AcceptanceCriteria: Admin action records actor/time/reason and propagates to search index.

Title: Implement abuse/fraud signals for trials, unlocks and contacts
UserStory: As the business, free-candidate allowance and communication channels resist abuse.
ScopeSummary: Velocity/device/legal-entity/repeated signup/contact risk signals and review hooks.
AcceptanceCriteria: Risk rules can throttle/hold without silently deleting data.

Title: Build candidate/employer hiring funnel analytics
UserStory: As product, we can optimize conversion and time-to-fill.
ScopeSummary: Search/impression/view/save/apply/unlock/paywall/contact/interview/offer/hire funnels.
AcceptanceCriteria: Metrics are organisation/job/role/geography segmentable without exposing raw PII.

Title: Build subscription and paywall conversion analytics
UserStory: As product/finance, we understand trial/free-to-paid conversion.
ScopeSummary: 5-free usage, sixth-attempt paywall, checkout, paid activation, renewal/churn, add-ons.
AcceptanceCriteria: Can calculate conversion from paywall impression to paid entitlement.

Title: Build plan/entitlement/promotion admin configuration
UserStory: As admins, pricing metadata/limits/products can change without code deploy.
ScopeSummary: New plan versions, entitlement limits, promotion products/effective dates.
AcceptanceCriteria: Sold plan versions remain immutable; changes create new version.

Title: Build taxonomy/role-template administration
UserStory: As admins, taxonomy evolves safely.
ScopeSummary: Versioned role/alias/specialisation/requirement template changes, activation/deprecation.
AcceptanceCriteria: Existing job/application snapshots retain historical meaning.

Title: Build support diagnostics for auth/billing/job/application/unlock issues
UserStory: As support, I can diagnose a customer problem without direct DB access.
ScopeSummary: Safe timeline views for session, webhook, entitlement, unlock and application events.
AcceptanceCriteria: PII masked by default; privileged reveal separately audited.

Title: Load-test job/candidate search, facets and unlock hot paths
UserStory: As the platform, peak mobile/recruiter traffic meets SLOs.
ScopeSummary: Cursor pagination, facet caches, index throughput, paywall/unlock concurrency.
AcceptanceCriteria: P95/P99 targets met; no double free-unlock consumption under concurrency.

Title: Perform auth/session/OTP/tenant/paywall penetration review
UserStory: As the business, critical security and commercial gates cannot be bypassed.
ScopeSummary: OTP abuse, token theft/reuse, IDOR/tenant isolation, entitlement/paywall bypass, PII leakage.
AcceptanceCriteria: No unresolved critical/high findings at go-live.

Title: Build migration and seed automation
UserStory: As operations, environments can be created/upgraded reproducibly.
ScopeSummary: Schema migrations, taxonomy seeds, plan/entitlement seed, feature flags.
AcceptanceCriteria: Fresh and upgrade-path environment tests pass.

Title: Implement backup, restore, DR and reconciliation runbooks
UserStory: As operations, service can recover from data/integration failures.
ScopeSummary: SQL backup/restore, search rebuild, billing reconciliation, outbox replay.
AcceptanceCriteria: Restore and search rebuild drill completed.

Title: Create SLO dashboards, alerts and business guardrails
UserStory: As operations/product, failures and commercial anomalies are visible.
ScopeSummary: Auth success, API latency/errors, search freshness, webhook lag, alert failure, unlock/paywall anomalies.
AcceptanceCriteria: Actionable alerts have owners/runbooks; no raw PII in logs.

Title: Run end-to-end regression/UAT including five-candidate boundary
UserStory: As stakeholders, the integrated SaaS flow is release-ready.
ScopeSummary: Candidate OTP->filter->apply; employer OTP->job->5 unlocks->6th paywall->pay->unlock; alerts/share/promotion/moderation.
AcceptanceCriteria: All P0 acceptance scenarios pass with traceable evidence.

Title: Complete production launch readiness and operational handoff
UserStory: As the organisation, IndiaWorks can launch with controlled risk.
ScopeSummary: Go-live checklist, support/escalation, pricing/plan config, feature flags, rollback, ownership.
AcceptanceCriteria: Go/no-go signoff complete; production smoke test and rollback plan verified.

Title: Test accessibility, low-bandwidth and mobile resilience
UserStory: As frontline candidates, the app works on constrained devices/networks.
ScopeSummary: Retry/idempotency, offline/poor network states, accessibility labels, localization readiness.
AcceptanceCriteria: Critical flows pass target device/network test matrix.
